relationships.evidence_quote: After the application of AdipoRon, the protein level of TNF-α in the ipsilateral spinal cord was significantly lower in the SNI+AdipoRon group than in the SNI+Vehicle group

relationships.subject: AdipoRon
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these results demonstrate that AdipoRon downregulates the number of microglia and the protein level of TNF-α in the ipsilateral spinal cord of SNI mice.

relationships.subject: AdipoRon
relationships.evidence_quote: After treatment with AdipoRon, the protein expression of AdipoR1 was significantly reduced, and the protein expression of p-AMPK was significantly increased in the ipsilateral spinal cord of the SNI+AdipoRon group

relationships.subject: AdipoRon
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggest that AdipoRon is able to alleviate mechanical nociception in SNI mice.

key_findings: AdipoRon alleviated mechanical nociception in SNI mice and reduced spinal TNF-alpha and microglia number.
AdipoRon reversed LPS-induced TNF-alpha, AdipoR1 increase and p-AMPK decrease in BV2 cells.
